# ClubHouse - University Club Management System

> Centralized web platform for university student clubs, events, recruitment applications, and campus announcements.

## System Overview

ClubHouse provides university students, club executives, and administrators with tools to discover clubs, register for campus events, apply for recruitment drives, and manage campus organizations.

## Core Navigation & Routes

- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Main user overview showing upcoming events, active club memberships, and campus announcements.
- [Clubs Catalog](/clubs): Directory of active university clubs, department affiliations, executive members, and joining guidelines.
- [Events Calendar](/events): Campus-wide events schedule with registration links, ticket availability, and venue details.
- [Recruitment Drives](/recruitment): Active club executive and member recruitment postings with online application forms.
- [Announcements](/announcements): Official campus and club updates, notices, and activity logs.
- [User Profile](/profile): Personal user settings, registered events history, and submitted recruitment applications.

## Authentication & Access

- [Login](/login): Authentication portal for institutional student and admin accounts.
- [Register](/register): Account registration page for new students.

## Developer & API Documentation

- [API Health Check](/api/health): Backend service health status endpoint.
- [OpenAPI Spec](/api/documentation): Backend REST API endpoint documentation.
